snippet.title: Toward the Moon Game- Trailer
snippet.description:
TR-Eski dönemlerden, uzay çağına kadar sürekli engelleri geçerek aya ulaşmak. Ama unutulmaması gerekir ki yoğun engeller, sinir bozucu etaplar... kaydetmek yok, geri dönüş yok. Atmosferi ve müzikleri ile mükemmel bir deneyime hazır olun...
steam takip için ziyaret ediniz
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828290/Toward_the_Moon/

EN-From ancient times to the space age, constantly overcoming obstacles to reach the moon. But it must not be forgotten that there are intense obstacles, frustrating stages... no saving, no turning back. Get ready for a perfect experience with its atmosphere and music...
Visit for Steam follow
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828290/Toward_the_Moon/
